title: TriQua: Reconciling Granularity and Context in Factuality Evaluation
author: arXiv cs.AI
summary: TriQua introduces a framework for evaluating factuality of language model outputs by reconciling fine-grained atomicity with broader contextual coherence. It addresses limitations in existing metrics that either focus on individual facts without context or consider context but lose granularity, offering a more balanced assessment. This work contributes a valuable tool for reliable LLM output verification.
